assets.content:
LAYOUT SPEC for the retired printer's 2024 adviser introduction-card press PDF (flat, single record, fonts embedded; to be reverse-engineered downstream into a live merge template).

Document: single card, 85 x 55 mm LANDSCAPE, trim = media box, NO bleed box present (0 mm bleed), all fonts embedded and subset. This is one of the two files the retired printer sent; it prints identically to adviser_card_2025_press.pdf.

WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE PRINTED (five apparent fields plus a portrait and a mark):
- Left third: a rectangular PORTRAIT of the adviser, head and shoulders, bleeding to the left and top card edges.
- Right two-thirds, top: the ADVISER NAME in a transitional serif, large (embedded as 'NW Founders Text').
- Under the name: a CREDENTIALS line in small caps (e.g. CFA, CAIA), Compass Brass #9C8452.
- Under that: a PRACTICE line naming the adviser's sector, Slate Grey #5B646E.
- Lower block: DIRECT DIAL and EMAIL on two lines in a quiet humanist sans (embedded as 'NW Grotesk'), Federal Navy #1E2A3A.
- Small compass-rose mark bottom-right, Compass Brass.
- Ground: Paper White #F5F3EE.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY SET (the reverse-engineering trap):
- This file was built with the portrait PLACED AS A LINKED GRAPHIC. It therefore converts to native with a REAL rectangular GRAPHIC FRAME carrying an integer item id in the left third, into which a per-record photograph can be bound.
- The NAME, the CREDENTIALS line, the PRACTICE line, the DIAL and the EMAIL each sit in SEPARATE addressable TEXT FRAMES.
- So the frame inventory a conversion exposes is: five separate text frames + one graphic frame (integer item id) + a small decorative path group for the mark. A per-adviser portrait binds cleanly through the graphic frame, and each copy field maps to its own frame.

FIELD LABELS the downstream mapping must resolve (present as content, not visible tokens): NAME | CREDENTIALS | PRACTICE | DIRECT_DIAL | EMAIL | PORTRAIT

NO SIGNAL: nothing in this file's name, its 85 x 55 mm geometry, its embedded fonts or the printed result distinguishes it from the 2025 file. Which of the two can carry a per-record portrait is knowable only after converting both and reading the exported interchange.

Colours: Paper White #F5F3EE ground, Federal Navy #1E2A3A dial/email, Compass Brass #9C8452 credentials line and mark, Slate Grey #5B646E practice line.

assets.defect_engineered: THE FLATTENED FILE (the trap) — was flattened before press, so it converts to ONE continuous text story with ZERO graphic frames; it can carry copy only by offset arithmetic and CANNOT bind a per-record portrait by any route; prints identically to the 2024 file, so a run built on this one prints the same static face on all eight cards
assets.content:
LAYOUT SPEC for the retired printer's 2025 adviser introduction-card press PDF (flat, single record, fonts embedded; the printer's reissue, to be reverse-engineered downstream).

Document: single card, 85 x 55 mm LANDSCAPE, trim = media box, NO bleed box present (0 mm bleed), all fonts embedded and subset. This is the other of the two files the retired printer sent; it prints byte-for-byte identically to adviser_card_2024_press.pdf and the client cannot see any difference between the two.

WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE PRINTED (identical to the 2024 file):
- Left third: a rectangular PORTRAIT of the adviser, head and shoulders, bleeding to the left and top card edges.
- Right two-thirds, top: the ADVISER NAME in a transitional serif, large.
- Under the name: a CREDENTIALS line in small caps, Compass Brass #9C8452.
- Under that: a PRACTICE line, Slate Grey #5B646E.
- Lower block: DIRECT DIAL and EMAIL, quiet humanist sans, Federal Navy #1E2A3A.
- Small compass-rose mark bottom-right, Compass Brass.
- Ground: Paper White #F5F3EE.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY SET (the reverse-engineering trap):
- This file was FLATTENED before it went to press. The portrait was rasterised and baked into the page artwork, so there is NO graphic frame anywhere on the card and NOTHING for a per-record photograph to bind into by any route.
- The NAME, the CREDENTIALS line, the PRACTICE line, the DIAL and the EMAIL all collapse into a SINGLE CONTINUOUS TEXT STORY inside ONE text frame; there are no separate addressable fields.
- So the frame inventory a conversion exposes is: exactly one continuous text story (one text frame) + one flattened background image + a small decorative path group, and ZERO bindable graphic frames. Copy can be driven only by offset arithmetic computed from the reconstructed story text; a per-record portrait is impossible.

FIELD LABELS present in the single story (as content, not addressable tokens): NAME | CREDENTIALS | PRACTICE | DIRECT_DIAL | EMAIL

NO SIGNAL: nothing in this file's name (being the newer 2025 reissue does not make it the usable one), its 85 x 55 mm geometry, its embedded fonts or the printed result distinguishes it from the 2024 file. That this file cannot carry a portrait is knowable only after converting both and reading the exported interchange.

Colours: Paper White #F5F3EE ground, Federal Navy #1E2A3A dial/email, Compass Brass #9C8452 credentials line and mark, Slate Grey #5B646E practice line.
